 if not path.name.isdigit():continue

 except (OSError,UnicodeError):continue
 if argv and argv[0].endswith('/qev-native-study') and '--output' in argv and 'current-uncalibrated-part' in argv[argv.index('--output')+1]:
  os.kill(int(path.name),signal.SIGTERM);killed.append(int(path.name))

  fields=line.split('\t')

  complete[fields[0]]=line

for phase in [True,False]:
 subset=[x for x in rows if x['id'] not in complete and (x['id'] in dev)==phase]
 for row in sorted(subset,key=lambda x:x['tokens'],reverse=True):
  i=min(range(2),key=totals.__getitem__);bins[i].append(jobs[row['id']]);totals[i]+=row['tokens']
for i,lines in enumerate(bins):(r/f'eval/jobs-resume-part{i}.tsv').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
(r/'native-resume.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(reason='Prioritize fixed development panel before final panel; reuse every completed row',terminated_pids=killed,completed_prefix_rows=len(complete),discarded_incomplete_rows=discarded,remaining_tokens=totals),indent=2)+'\n');print('Retained',len(complete),'rows; prioritized development panel')
